answer.rationale: The 18% spend cut is met by the low-cost quote, but the line is at 94% with no buffer and the primary contract dies in 14 days, so a primary switch would raise delivery risk and TCO even if unit price falls. c1 says incumbent renewal avoided migration and delivery interruption; c4 says benchmarking at renewal moved the incumbent on price and terms—the competing quote is leverage for that, not a reason to cut over yet. c2 (prior low-cost primary move, quick onboard) may or may not transfer to this cycle and must be checked before treating switch as low-risk. Deferral and second-source do not settle the expiring primary. Negotiate the renewal against the quote; do not assume an 18% concession or a painless cutover.
